facts.text: The user wants the assistant to act as an English translator, spelling corrector, and improver.
The user will speak to the assistant in any language.
The assistant should detect the language, translate it, and answer in the corrected and improved version of the user's text in English.
The user wants the assistant to replace simplified A0-level words and sentences with more beautiful and elegant upper-level English words and sentences.
The user wants the assistant to keep the meaning the same while making the text more literary.
The user wants the assistant to reply only with the correction and improvements and nothing else.
The user provided the Chinese text: "床前明月光，疑似地上霜。舉動望明月，低頭思故鄉。"
